input.title: Input Options
input.description: Parameters for finding and handling input data for analysis.

ex_dir.description: BAM file(s) to use in the analysis.
ex_dir.help_text: This accepts one of three cases: (i) the path to a single BAM file; (ii) the path to a top-level directory containing BAM files; (iii) the path to a directory containing one level of sub-directories which in turn contain BAM files. In the first and second case, a sample name can be supplied with `--sample`. In the last case, the data is assumed to be multiplexed with the names of the sub-directories as barcodes. In this case, a sample sheet can be provided with `--sample_sheet`.

samples.title: Sample Options
samples.description: Parameters that relate to samples such as sample sheets and sample names.

sample.description: A single sample name for non-multiplexed data. Permissible if passing a single .fastq(.gz) file or directory of .fastq(.gz) files.

output.title: Output Options
output.description: Parameters for saving and naming workflow outputs.

out_dir.description: Directory for output of all workflow results.

disable_ping.description: Enable to prevent sending a workflow ping.

process_label.description: The main process label for template processes to use by default
